WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_distinct
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY p.sku
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  GROUP BY p.sku
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, sold.units_sold, COALESCE(ret.units_returned,0) AS units_returned,
       sold.units_sold - COALESCE(ret.units_returned,0) AS net_units, sold.n_lines, sold.n_distinct
FROM sold JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = sold.sku AND cp.is_current
LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.sku = sold.sku
ORDER BY sold.units_sold DESC
LIMIT 8

WITH per AS (SELECT MIN(calendar_date) a, MAX(calendar_date) b FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5),
lines AS (
  SELECT SUM(f.quantity) u, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) keys, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_name) names
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN per.a AND per.b
),
ctl AS (SELECT SUM(units_sold) cu, COUNT(*) days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, per WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN per.a AND per.b)
SELECT per.a, per.b, lines.*, ctl.* FROM per, lines, ctl

WITH per AS (SELECT MIN(calendar_date) AS a, MAX(calendar_date) AS b FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5),
lines AS (
  SELECT SUM(f.quantity) AS u, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS line_keys, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS mx, MAX(s.store_name) AS sname
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN per.a AND per.b
),
ctl AS (SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS cu, COUNT(*) AS n_days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, per WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN per.a AND per.b)
SELECT per.a, per.b, lines.*, ctl.* FROM per, lines, ctl
